cases.heading: Collaborations in practice
cases.intro: Two trajectories, written out in full: what the situation was, what I did, and what it delivered.

SCP.client: The Netherlands Institute for Social Research (SCP)
SCP.situation: Research into integration and participation called for deeper insight into the experiences and perspectives of Eritrean communities. The existing research approaches and communication methods didn't always connect with the target group.
SCP.approach: I interpreted the cultural context and the communication patterns that come with it. I brought in perspectives from the Eritrean community, helped formulate culturally appropriate research questions, and improved the connection between researchers and the target group.
SCP.result: More nuanced, context-sensitive insights. Communication with the target group became more effective, with greater mutual understanding and more reliable information.

VOZ.situation: VOZ housed newly settled refugees in Ommoord-Zevenkamp, including many Eritrean newcomers. The team had no Tigrinya-speaking colleagues and struggled to assess what residents needed.
VOZ.approach: I reached out to VOZ on my own initiative in June 2015. I helped Eritrean refugees with integration and participation activities, through the weekly walk-in hours and beyond, via home visits and phone contact. I worked as an interpreter for Dutch-speaking colleagues as well as an independent support worker, and contributed practical solutions in team meetings.
VOZ.result: The VOZ team gained the knowledge and skills to guide Eritrean newcomers in building a life in the Netherlands.

items.quote: I experience Bet-El as an honest and highly reliable professional who plays an important role as a cultural connector and interpreter/translator. In our collaboration she is pleasant to work with, open to different perspectives, and always thinks along constructively. She consistently keeps her commitments, is flexible in her approach, and often delivers more than expected. Her commitment and care make her a valuable partner to work with.
